name: InterPro

version.value: InterPro 110.0 (interpro-version response header of the API, 2026-10-25)

scope: Protein families, domains and sites integrating member databases (Pfam, SMART, PROSITE, CDD, PANTHER, CATH-Gene3D and others listed by the API).

licence.name: CC0 1.0 Universal for InterPro, Pfam, PRINTS and SFLD downloadable data; InterProScan under the Apache License (InterPro documentation licence page)
licence.redistribution: Free, including commercial use; cite the resource and the member databases. Signature collections of included scanning tools may carry other terms.

coverage_limitations: Domain membership is predicted by signatures

reuse_decision.rationale: Per-protein retrieval of InterPro and member-database matches (with residue locations) for the UniProt proteins our MaveDB score sets are about; the bulk match files are not needed for that set.

status.notes: API returns JSON; per-protein matches for the MaveDB proteins are fetched by acquisition/fetch_per_protein.py.
